description: Foundation: project scaffold (pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, package __init__ files), the single-source-of-truth config/pipeline.yaml, and ALL eight src/common modules with their pure-Python pytest unit tests. Everything in FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depends on the names, paths, contracts, and helpers established here. Spark/boto3/PyYAML imports must be lazy (inside functions) so modules byte-compile and import on the bare Windows host (Python 3.14, pyspark/java absent). Target Python 3.11 syntax only.
steps: Create pyproject.toml: project metadata, requires-python intent '>=3.11,<3.12', [tool.black] target-version=['py311'], [tool.ruff] target-version='py311' and basic lint selection, and [tool.pytest.ini_options] testpaths=['tests']. Create requirements.txt: PyYAML and boto3 (installed), plus pyspark==3.5.* marked as optional/smoke-only in a comment (NOT installed locally).

Create config/pipeline.yaml as the single source of truth (design §2/§3/§6.5): project: ocbc-poc; env: dev; region (e.g. ap-southeast-1); buckets (datalake + athena-results base names, account id interpolated at TF/runtime); databases map for the 6 Glue DBs (ocbc_poc_dev_{landing,bronze,silver,canonical,gold,audit}); masking: {salt: <demo-salt>}; generator.row_counts: {customers: [90,110], accounts: [140,160], cards: [110,130], transactions: [700,900]}; dq_rules tree per table with each expectation carrying a severity, including dq_rules.customers.country_allowed: [SG,US,MY,GB,IN,AU] and row_count>=1 severity CRITICAL only for transactions, WARN for customers/accounts/cards.
Create empty package markers: src/__init__.py, src/common/__init__.py, src/jobs/__init__.py, data/__init__.py, data/generator/__init__.py, tests/__init__.py.

Create src/common/config_loader.py: load_config(path='config/pipeline.yaml') -> Config exposing project, env, region, buckets, databases, masking, dq_rules, generator (with generator.row_counts). Parse with yaml at CALL time (lazy import), validate required keys (project, env, region, buckets, databases, masking, dq_rules) and required sub-key masking.salt; a missing key raises a fatal error tagged event=config_fail. Import-safe with nothing installed.

Create src/common/io_paths.py (pure strings, no AWS/Spark): s3_layer_prefix(layer, table), warehouse_uri(), lineage_path(run_id, job, table) -> s3://.../lineage/<run_id>/<job>/<table>.json, quality_path(run_id, job, table), audit_json_path(run_id, job, table), glue_db(layer), iceberg_table(layer, table) -> glue_catalog.<db>.<table>. All three operational-artifact paths take a table arg (Finding 1, per-table keying).

Create src/common/logging_util.py: get_logger(run_id, layer, table=None) -> stdlib logging.Logger with a single-line JSON formatter emitting run_id, layer, table, event, message, ts; log_event(logger, event, **fields) with the stable event enum (job_start, read_done, dq_start, dq_pass, dq_fail, write_done, job_end, ...); timed(logger, event) context manager adding duration_ms. Stdlib only.

Create src/common/masking.py: pure functions mask_name (first char + '***'), mask_email (first local char + '***@' + domain), mask_phone (keep last 2), tokenize_id(v, salt) = first 16 chars of lowercase-hex SHA-256 of UTF-8-encoded (salt + value) in salt-prefix order, generalize_dob(v) -> int|None (birth year), mask_pan (keep last 4 -> '**** **** **** 1234'); plus apply_masking(df, table, salt) Spark wrapper that maps the §4 per-table PII column->method table onto a DataFrame with pyspark imported lazily inside the function.

Create src/common/lineage.py: per-table start_lineage(run_id, job, layer_from, layer_to, table) -> LineageBuilder carrying the table; LineageBuilder.add_input/add_output(dataset, fmt, row_count=None, columns=None) and add_column_mapping(output_col, inputs, transform); emit(builder, s3_client=None, local_dir=None) -> path serializes the §7.1 JSON (schema_version, run_id, job, table, layer_from, layer_to, started_at, ended_at, status, inputs, outputs, column_mappings, metrics) and writes to io_paths.lineage_path(run_id, job, builder.table) (boto3 if s3_client else local_dir); glue_table key present for cataloged datasets, omitted/null for the uncataloged landing input. register_glue_table(catalog, database, table, location, fmt, columns=None): fmt='parquet' REQUIRES columns (populate StorageDescriptor.Columns via boto3, else raise ValueError), fmt iceberg is a no-op create-if-not-exists. Lazy boto3 import.

Create src/common/quality.py: Expectation dataclass (name, kind, column(s), params, severity 'critical'|'warn'); builders expect_not_null(col), expect_unique(cols), expect_in_set(col, allowed), expect_range(col, min, max), expect_referential(col, ref_table_name, ref_col) storing the parent NAME string only, expect_row_count(min, max=None). run_expectations(df, expectations, run_id, job, table, ref_dfs) evaluates count-based in Spark (lazy pyspark), resolves referential via ref_dfs[ref_table_name] and raises a hard dq_fail if the key is absent, builds the §7.2 JSON, and stores scalar table on the returned QualityResult. QualityResult.passed True iff no critical failed; QualityResult carries run_id, job, table, critical_failed, warn_failed. emit_quality(result, s3_client=None, local_dir=None) writes io_paths.quality_path(result.run_id, result.job, result.table). enforce_gate(result) raises QualityGateError (custom exception) if a critical expectation failed and performs NO I/O.

Create src/common/audit.py: AuditRecord dataclass per §7.3 using field name table_name (never table); status restricted to {SUCCESS, DQ_FAILED, FAILED}; fields output_rows, rejected_rows, lineage_path, emr_application_id, spark_app_id declared Optional defaulting None (so the DQ-failure path never crashes on a missing field); input_rows, dq_passed, dq_critical_failed, quality_path, started_at, ended_at, duration_ms, run_id, job, layer_from, layer_to present. write_audit(spark, record, catalog, database, table='pipeline_runs', s3_json_dir=None) appends exactly ONE row per call to the Iceberg pipeline_runs table (create-if-not-exists, unpartitioned per §7.3) and writes a JSON copy via io_paths.audit_json_path; lazy pyspark import.

Create src/common/spark_session.py: build_spark(app_name, catalog='glue_catalog', warehouse=None, local=False) -> SparkSession configuring Iceberg via the Glue catalog (SparkCatalog + GlueCatalog catalog-impl + S3FileIO io-impl + warehouse + IcebergSparkSessionExtensions); when local=True swap to a hadoop catalog pointed at a local warehouse/ dir and skip Glue. pyspark imported INSIDE the function so the module compiles/imports without pyspark.

Create pytest unit tests under tests/: tests/test_io_paths.py (exact path strings incl. the <table> segment; iceberg_table format), tests/test_config_loader.py (loads the real config/pipeline.yaml; a config missing masking.salt raises config_fail), tests/test_masking.py (tokenize_id equals a precomputed literal to pin order/encoding/truncation; each mask fn deterministic and idempotent), tests/test_logging_util.py (logger emits single-line JSON with the required keys), tests/test_lineage.py (build a doc from dicts, assert §7.1 shape; landing input omits glue_table while a cataloged input carries it; emit to a temp local_dir writes <table>.json and two tables do not collide), tests/test_quality.py (enforce_gate raises on a critical-failed QualityResult and not otherwise; QualityResult.passed logic; §7.2 JSON shape built from a stub, no Spark), tests/test_audit.py (AuditRecord serializes to §7.3 JSON with key table_name and Optional fields None on the DQ-failure shape).
acceptance_criteria: `python -c "import yaml,pathlib; yaml.safe_load(pathlib.Path('config/pipeline.yaml').read_text())"` exits 0 and the parsed config contains generator.row_counts, masking.salt, and dq_rules.customers.country_allowed == [SG,US,MY,GB,IN,AU].
`python -m compileall src/common config` passes with no errors (modules compile without pyspark/boto3/PyYAML needed at import time).
Every src/common module imports successfully on the bare host (no Spark session constructed at import) and exposes its documented public functions.

`pytest tests/` passes: io_paths path strings (incl. <table>), config_loader required-key validation, tokenize_id matches the precomputed literal, enforce_gate raise/no-raise, lineage/quality/audit JSON shapes match §7.
No Python syntax or stdlib API newer than 3.11 is used; pyproject.toml pins black/ruff target-version py311.
verification: python -c "import yaml,pathlib; c=yaml.safe_load(pathlib.Path('config/pipeline.yaml').read_text()); assert c['generator']['row_counts']['transactions']==[700,900]; assert c['masking']['salt']; assert c['dq_rules']['customers']['country_allowed']==['SG','US','MY','GB','IN','AU']; print('config ok')"
findings:
FEAT-001 complete. Verification: `python -m compileall src/common config` OK; config assertion prints 'config ok'; `pytest tests/ -q` => 34 passed. All 8 common modules import on the bare host with no pyspark/boto3/PyYAML (lazy imports confirmed).

=== PUBLIC SIGNATURES (settled) ===
config_loader: load_config(path='config/pipeline.yaml') -> Config(frozen dataclass: project,env,region,buckets,databases,masking,dq_rules,generator,raw). Access row counts via cfg.generator['row_counts']['<table>'] and country set via cfg.dq_rules['customers']['country_allowed']. Raises config_loader.ConfigError (message tagged 'event=config_fail') on missing file/key/masking.salt.
io_paths: Introduced IoContext(frozen dataclass: datalake_bucket, db_prefix='ocbc_poc_dev', catalog='glue_catalog') carrying the resolved bucket+db base names, since account id is only known at TF/runtime. DEFAULT_CONTEXT has placeholder values. ALL builders take an optional trailing `ctx: IoContext | None = None` (None => DEFAULT_CONTEXT). FEAT-002/003 should build ONE IoContext from Config + account id and thread it through. Functions: s3_layer_prefix(layer,table,ctx=None)->'s3://<bucket>/<layer>/<table>/'; warehouse_uri(ctx=None)->'s3://<bucket>/warehouse/'; lineage_path(run_id,job,table,ctx=None); quality_path(run_id,job,table,ctx=None); audit_json_path(run_id,job,table,ctx=None) all ->'s3://<bucket>/<kind>/<run_id>/<job>/<table>.json'; glue_db(layer,ctx=None)->'ocbc_poc_dev_<layer>' (accepts landing/bronze/silver/canonical/gold/audit); iceberg_table(layer,table,ctx=None)->'glue_catalog.<db>.<table>'. Unknown layer raises ValueError.
logging_util: get_logger(run_id,layer,table=None)->logging.Logger (single-line JSON to stdout, keys: ts,run_id,layer,table,event,message + merged extras); log_event(logger,event,message='',**fields); timed(logger,event,**fields) ctx mgr emitting '<event>_start'/'<event>_end' with duration_ms. Stable event constants: EVENT_JOB_START/READ_DONE/DQ_START/DQ_PASS/DQ_FAIL/WRITE_DONE/JOB_END (also tuple EVENTS).
masking: pure fns mask_name(v), mask_email(v), mask_phone(v) (last 2 -> '****XX'), tokenize_id(v,salt)->first16(lowercasehex(sha256(utf8(salt+value)))) [salt-prefix], generalize_dob(v)->int|None (birth year), mask_pan(v)->'**** **** **** 1234'. All None/empty-safe and idempotent. PII_COLUMNS: dict[table]->{column: method} (methods: name,email,phone,token,pan,dob) drives apply_masking(df,table,salt)->DataFrame (lazy pyspark). NOTE: dob method REPLACES date_of_birth with a new int column 'birth_year' and DROPS date_of_birth (matches design S6.3 canonical schema). token masks national_id in place.
lineage: start_lineage(run_id,job,layer_from,layer_to,table)->LineageBuilder (carries table). Builder methods (chainable): add_input/add_output(dataset,fmt,row_count=None,columns=None,glue_table=None) [glue_table OMITTED from JSON when None => landing input stays uncataloged], add_column_mapping(output_col,inputs:list,transform:str), set_metrics(**metrics), to_dict(ended_at=None). emit(builder,s3_client=None,local_dir=None,ctx=None)->path (S3 via boto3 put_object when s3_client else writes <table>.json under local_dir). register_glue_table(catalog,database,table,location,fmt,columns=None): fmt='iceberg' no-op; fmt='parquet' REQUIRES columns=list[(name,glue_type)] else ValueError; create-if-not-exists (create_table, fallback update_table on AlreadyExists). Helper _split_s3(uri)->(bucket,key). SCHEMA_VERSION='1.0'.
quality: Expectation dataclass(name,kind,columns:list,params:dict,severity) with .ref_table_name/.ref_col properties reading params['ref_table']/['ref_col']. Builders: expect_not_null(col,severity='critical'), expect_unique(cols,severity='critical'), expect_in_set(col,allowed,severity='warn'), expect_range(col,min=None,max=None,severity='warn'), expect_referential(col,ref_table_name,ref_col,severity='critical'), expect_row_count(min,max=None,severity='warn'). kind strings: not_null,unique,in_set,range,referential,row_count. run_expectations(df,expectations,run_id,job,table,ref_dfs=None)->QualityResult (lazy pyspark, count-based; missing ref_dfs[name] for a referential => raises QualityGateError tagged event=dq_fail). QualityResult(run_id,job,table,evaluated_at,critical_failed,warn_failed,expectations) with .passed (True iff critical_failed==0) and .to_dict() (S7.2). emit_quality(result,s3_client=None,local_dir=None,ctx=None)->path. enforce_gate(result) raises quality.QualityGateError if not result.passed, NO I/O. QualityGateError is the custom exception. SEVERITY_CRITICAL='critical', SEVERITY_WARN='warn'.
audit: AuditRecord dataclass. REQUIRED fields: run_id,job,layer_from,layer_to,table_name(str, NOT 'table'),status,input_rows,dq_passed,dq_critical_failed,started_at,ended_at,duration_ms. OPTIONAL (default None): output_rows,rejected_rows,lineage_path,quality_path,emr_application_id,spark_app_id. __post_init__ validates status in {SUCCESS,DQ_FAILED,FAILED} (constants STATUS_SUCCESS/STATUS_DQ_FAILED/STATUS_FAILED, tuple STATUSES) else ValueError. to_dict() preserves declaration order (table_name key, never table). write_audit(spark,record,catalog,database,table='pipeline_runs',s3_json_dir=None,ctx=None): CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS unpartitioned iceberg + writeTo(...).append() ONE row + JSON mirror via io_paths.audit_json_path written through the Spark Hadoop FS (not boto3). DDL column list is module const _PIPELINE_RUNS_DDL_COLUMNS (matches S7.3).
spark_session: build_spark(app_name,catalog='glue_catalog',warehouse=None,local=False)->SparkSession (lazy pyspark inside). local=True => hadoop catalog on ./warehouse (or given dir), skip Glue; local=False => SparkCatalog + GlueCatalog catalog-impl + S3FileIO io-impl + optional warehouse + Iceberg extensions. _ICEBERG_EXTENSIONS const.

=== CONFIG KEY LAYOUT (config/pipeline.yaml) ===
project,env,region at top. buckets:{datalake,athena_results} (BASE names, account id appended at TF/runtime). databases:{landing,bronze,silver,canonical,gold,audit} (underscore names). masking:{salt}. generator:{row_counts:{customers:[90,110],accounts:[140,160],cards:[110,130],transactions:[700,900]}}. dq_rules:{<table>:{expectations:[{name,kind,column|columns,params,severity}], plus customers.country_allowed:[SG,US,MY,GB,IN,AU]}}. Expectation entries use 'column' (singular) for single-col kinds and 'columns' for unique; params holds allowed/min/max/ref_table/ref_col. row_count>=1 severity: CRITICAL for transactions, WARN for customers/accounts/cards.

=== DEVIATIONS / DECISIONS FOR FEAT-002/003 ===
1. io_paths needed concrete bucket/db base names to produce real strings; added IoContext (optional trailing arg, defaults to placeholders) rather than reading config inside io_paths (keeps it a pure string module per S5.8). Downstream jobs must construct IoContext(datalake_bucket=f'{buckets.datalake}-{account_id}', db_prefix='_'.join([project.replace('-','_')... ]) ) -- actually db_prefix is the literal 'ocbc_poc_dev'; derive as project.replace('-','_')+'_'+env. Thread the SAME ctx into every io_paths/lineage/quality/audit call in a job.
2. audit.write_audit writes the JSON mirror via the Spark Hadoop FileSystem (spark._jvm) instead of boto3, so a running Spark job needs no boto3 for the audit mirror. s3_json_dir overrides only the directory, keeps <table>.json filename.
3. masking dob method emits 'birth_year' int and drops 'date_of_birth' inside apply_masking, so silver_to_canonical does not need a separate birth_year step for customers.
4. tokenize_id precomputed literal pinned in test: tokenize_id('S1234567A','ocbc-poc-demo-salt-2025')=='e9b1164aa8b635be'.
5. QualityGateError (not a separate dq_fail type) is raised BOTH by enforce_gate on critical failure AND by run_expectations when a referential parent is missing from ref_dfs; both messages carry 'event=dq_fail'.
6. No --inject-dq-failure logic lives in common; that belongs to the generator/job (FEAT-002).
